title: ST_ToGeometry
description: Converts a geography to a geometry, optionally tessellating its edges using a tolerance.
kernels:
  - returns: geometry
    args: [geometry]
  - returns: geometry
    args: [geography]
  - returns: geometry
    args:
    - geography
    - name: tolerance
      type: double
      description: Maximum deviation in meters between a spherical edge and its planar approximation.
---

## Description

Converts a geography to a geometry by changing the edge interpretation from spherical
to planar. This is a metadata-only operation that does not modify the underlying
coordinate data. If the input is already a geometry, it is returned unchanged.

When `tolerance` is provided, geography edges are tessellated using spherical
interpolation before conversion. The tolerance is the maximum deviation in meters
between an original spherical edge and its planar approximation. This overload is
equivalent to `ST_TessellateGeom`.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ST_ToGeometry(ST_GeogFromText('POINT (-122.35 47.62)'));
```

```sql
SELECT ST_ToGeometry(
    ST_GeogFromText('LINESTRING (-10 50, 10 50)'),
    1000
);
```
